profile.headline: Software Engineer Senior at USAA
profile.summary:
With more than 15+ years of experience in the information technology industry throughout different projects as contractor or full time positions mainly working with web-based solutions and applications using .Net technologies and involving analysis, development, documentation, coding, testing, support and implementation. Excellent client-facing abilities, attention to detail, adaptability, building relationships, problem solving, working autonomously, quick learning skills, Identifying problems, designing systems and experience working onsite at locations. 

•	15+ years of experience as a web application developer and web design using programming languages and tools mostly using Microsoft platform as per the company requirements like C# .NET, SQL Server, HTML5, classic asp, javaScript, Ext js, html, xml, xsl, Json, Ajax, source safe, team foundation server, Esri ArcGIS and Bing Maps. Actually exploring Angular js, bootstrap.
•	4 years of experience as a software Engineer / Technical in site. Analyzing user requirements through gathering requirements, writing use cases, activity diagrams, etc.for the company’s web services to ensure the application tools functionality. 
•	Prototyping and following CMMI process. Proposing design patterns and Involved on software architecture, design, development and implementation of web based applications and just a few windows apps.
•	Programming, integrating, enhance performance and helping with the migration of web applications. Responsible for the Analysis and design of structures for several projects. Management and responsible for up to 3 to 4 people team on previous projects.
•	1 years of experience leading my own business of software development and technical support in 2001.

positions.title: APPLICATION DEVELOPER LEVEL V
positions.description:
Tools used: Python, C# .NET, AJAX, SQL Server 2005, Oracle, JavaScript, HTML, Css, bootstrap, java, Sencha Ext JavaScript v6.2, SVN, IIS, Cygwin
•	Upgrading a web site used to get information from indexes and commodities which originally was created with the Sencha ExtJs framework 3.4 and now required with a more updated version like ExtJs framework 6.2
•	Adapting and redesigning the css style sheets and layouts for the index online web site using bootstrap and making sure ASP .Net MVC structure works correctly with the new updated Extjs framework objects on the front end.
•	Working with multi-threaded services for the generation of cached information related to commodity indexes using c#, Cygwin, MSMQ (Microsoft Message Queuing), SQL Server and Oracle.
•	Applying design patterns to classes coded with Python with the objective to provide solution to problems and facilitates the development of highly cohesive modules with minimal coupling.
•	Designing and implementing new filters for a cacher process to speed up the time for data generation in the multithread environment.
•	Light fixes and maintenance to some legacy java applications used to extract information used by other services.

positions.title: Application Developer Sr.
positions.description:
Tools used: HTML5, CSS, D3, Ext javascript framework, Ironpython, Ptk scripting (internal framework), Visual Studio 2010/2015, C# .NET, deep JavaScript and Jason, Ajax, Silverlight for hot fixes on older applications, SQL Server, Oracle, HTML, Bing Maps, Esri ArcGIS to create and share interactive maps with javascript, TortoiseSVN.

Develop company's .Net web-based visualization products with a federated data access approach and centered on UI with Extjs framework, javascript, HMTL5, ironpython and services through the use of c#, SQL Server and Oracle. Deliver quality code that meets the business requirements in a timely manner for the projects (in line with the project schedule).
Participated on designing, coding, and debugging large-scale, enterprise-level, multi-tiered, multi-thread environment.

positions.title: WEB APPLICATIONS ANALYST / DEVELOPER
positions.description: Developing XML Web Services and Server Components with Microsoft Visual C# and the Microsoft .NET Framework. Providing support for the web site, COM+ components, SQL database and the web services, bug correction for web applications using .NET framework version 2.0, 3.5 and 4.0, HTML, JavaScript, XML, SQL Server 2000/2005/2008 and enable Bug tracing, Message tracing and logging for troubleshooting. Using AGILE or WATERFALL on projects and also responsible to guide other members of the team in all the project activities, making sure the web applications are using the correct design patterns to match the requirements. Using CMMI (Capability Maturity Model Integration) Level 2/3 (requirements doc., analysis, use cases document, flow diagrams, activities diagrams, component diagrams, check lists, deployment diagrams, unitary testing document, estimation of times for the project, etc.). Leading technical teams, taking requirements and analyze, design and develop those requirements.

company.name: GMAC INSURANCE (Abaseguros) MEXICO through consultant company: NORTHWARE S.A. de C.V.

positions.title: WEB APPLICATIONS ANALYST / DEVELOPER
positions.description: Analysis, Design and development for a web application who was the link between 2 systems, the web application let the users from an old system of Human Resources ”SURH” (made with Cobol) migrate the information available to brand new structures for SAP. Gather requirements from users and helpng with the coordination of people to obtain and validate the information for the new system. Leading of a technical team of 3 people and included on regular meetings with the team and users. Responsible to manage an SQL database and providing support to the web applications error reports. Build, optimize, support and correct script and stored procedures, triggers, indexes, DTS´s with SQL Server 2005/2008. Write documentation for the project (requirements, analysis, use cases, diagrams, check lists, etc.)

company.name: CERVECERIA Cuauhtémoc Moctezuma (FEMSA Group) through consultant company NORTHWARE S.A. de C.V.

positions.title: ANALYST – DEVELOPER (Front and Back End)
positions.description: Analysis, Design, development and implementation of a web application for CEMEX South America (Colombia, Costa Rica, Venezuela, Panama, Puerto Rico, Dominican Republic, and Mexico) and also CEMEX Bangladesh.	Understanding client requirements and write documentation of the project with UML. Build, support, correct and improve scripts and stored procedures with SQL 2005. Create and modify Component methods (COM+). Add new functionalities to the web portal. Enable Bug tracing, Message tracing and logging and be able to respond to errors reported.

company.name: NEORIS Campus CX Networks through consultant company Tesis de Mexico S.A.
